senses.gloss:
mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Of or relating to divinity or a deity, divine, celestial, &c.
mn. (-वः-वं)
Destiny, fate, fortune.
n. (-वं)
1 The part of the hand sacred to the gods; the tips of the fingers, (some exclude the thumbs.)
2 One of the forms of marriage; the gift of a daughter at a sacrifice to the officiating priest.
f. (-वी)
A division of medicine, the medical use of charms, prayers, &c.
E.
देव a deity, and अञ् affix of reference or relation.

n. (-र्म्म)
Burnt-offering, oblations to the gods.
E.
दैव, and कर्म्म rite.

f. (-की)
The mother of KṚṢṆA.
E.
देवक father of the lady, affix of descent अण्, fem. affix ङीष्: see देवकी.

m. (-नः)
KṚṢṆA.
E.
दैवकी as above, नन्दन a son; also देवकीनन्दन.

mf. (-दः-दा)
A conjuror or fortune-teller.
E.
दैव fortune, and कोविद skilful.

m. (-कः)
A fatalist.
E.
दैव, and चिन्तक who thinks of.

f. (-न्ता)
Fatalism, reliance on fate.
E.
दैव, and चिन्ता thinking; also दैवचिन्तनं.

mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
Prophetic, foretelling, acquainted with fate.
m. (-ज्ञः)
An astrologer.
f. (-ज्ञा)
A female fortune-teller.
E.
दैव, and ज्ञ who knows.

mfn. (-तः-ती-तं)
1 Of or relating to a god.
mn. (-तः-तं)
1 A god, a deity.
2 An idol.
n. (-तं)
A number of gods.
E.
देवता a deity, अण् pleonastick or referential affix.

m. (-पः)
1 The eye.
2 A heavenly lamp.
E.
दैव, and दीप a lamp.

m. (-कः)
Hardness of fortune, unpropitiousness^1 of fate.
E.
दैव, and दुर्विपाक unfavourableness.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Fated, willed, predestined.
2 Trusting to fate, a fatalist.
E.
दैव fate, &c. पर after, according to.

m. (-श्नः)
Astrology, fortune-telling.
E.
दैव fate, &c. प्रश्न asking.

m. (-गः)
An age of the gods or immortals: see दैत्ययुग.

m. (-गः)
The occurrence of any unforeseen event, the intervention of destiny.
E.
दैव, and योग juncture.

m. (-कः)
The servant or worshipper of an evil spirit.

m. (-कः)
An astrologer, a fortune-teller.
E.
दैव fate, लिख to write, ण्वुल् aff.

f. (-णी)
A voice from heaven.
E.
दैव, and वाणी speech.

m. (-रिः)
1 YAMA.
2 SATURN.
f. (-री)
YAMUNĀ.
E.
दिवाकर the sun, and इञ patron. aff.

ind.
By chance, by accident, unavoidably, fatally.
E.
the 5th case of दैव used as a particle.

mfn. (-धी-धिनी-धि)
Subject or obedient to the gods.
E.
दैव divine (will), अनुरोधिन् assenting to.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Dependant upon destiny.
E.
दैव, and आयत्त subject to.

n. (-रं)
The natural enmity between the gods and Asuras.
E.
देव, and असुर, with अण् added in this sense.

m. (-त्रः)
A day of the gods, the human year: see दैत्याहोरात्र.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Of or relating to the gods, divine, deific, &c.
E.
देव a deity, and ठञ् aff.

f. (-ढा)
A woman married according to the Daiva ritual.
E.
दैव, and ऊढा married.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Ill-fated, unfortunate, unlucky.
E.
दैव, and उपहत struck by; also with कन्, दैवोपहतकः.

n. (-व्यं)
Fate, fortune.
E.
देव a deity, and यञ् affix: see दैव.
